description: Early voting starts today in person and it is time to Get Out The Vote! Join us on the doors this Saturday with special guest Mallory McMorrow. Every vote counts and we need you to help us get across the finish line. Training and a walking buddy can be provided! https://www.mobilize.us/mcclusk
